newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa okays bills in sterling listing.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa okays bills in sterling listing.

text.p: The Buenos Aires Stock Exchange said it approved the listing of Argentina's 10-year external Treasury bills LEX 53 for 200 million pound sterling.
The issue makes part of an already announced medium term programme of up to $11 billion, the Bolsa said in a press release late on Thursday.
The bills will carry a fixed annual interest rate of 10 percent to be calculated on a 30 days basis divided by 360.
Amortization will be integral at maturity June 25, 2007.
Main payment agent will be the Chase Manhattan Bank.
The bills will also be listed in the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and Argentina's Electronic Open Market SA (MAE).
